related_questions.question: What is the number one food to lower cholesterol?

text_blocks.snippet: Oatmeal is often cited as a top food for lowering cholesterol due to its high soluble fiber content, which helps bind to and remove cholesterol from the body. Other beneficial foods include fatty fish (like salmon), nuts, avocados, and foods fortified with plant sterols/stanols.

list.title: Oats and Whole Grains:
list.snippet: Oats and other whole grains contain soluble fiber, which is particularly effective at lowering LDL ("bad") cholesterol.

list.title: Fatty Fish:
list.snippet: Fish like salmon, mackerel, and tuna are rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which can help reduce triglycerides and inflammation.

list.title: Nuts:
list.snippet: Almonds, walnuts, and other nuts are a good source of healthy fats, fiber, and protein, which can help lower LDL cholesterol.

list.title: Avocados:
list.snippet: Avocados contain oleic acid, a monounsaturated fat that can help reduce LDL cholesterol.

list.title: Foods with Plant Sterols/Stanols:
list.snippet: These substances, found in some fortified foods like margarines and orange juice, help block cholesterol absorption.
